content.text: Use Case: Import employee records from a CSV file and save them into a database.

items: Process each record (ItemProcessor – optional, e.g., validate or transform)
Chunk size 100 → 100 records are processed and written in a single transaction.
RunIdIncrementer allows multiple executions with the same job parameters.

content.text: Use Case: Read employee data from XML and export it to a JSON file.

items: Converts XML to JSON in batch mode.

content.text: Use Case: Clean temporary files or send a report email.

items: Tasklet is suitable for one-off or repeated tasks that do not involve chunk-oriented processing.

content.text: Use Case: Archive old records from orders table and delete them after archiving.

items: Combines chunk-oriented step (read/process/write) with a Tasklet step (deletion).
Supports multiple steps in a single job for complex workflows.

content.text: Use Case: ETL process – Extract data from DB, transform it, and load to another DB.

items: Step 1: Extract data from source DB (JdbcCursorItemReader)
Step 3: Load data into target DB (JdbcBatchItemWriter)
This is a real-world ETL job.
Each step is modular → easier to maintain and monitor.
